Aurum Muriaticum Kalinatum.



Double Chloride of Potassium and Gold. K. Cl, Au Cl 3 ,
         2 H 2 O.



Clinical. ─   Uterus, hæmorrhage from; induration
        of.



Characteristics. ─   An unproved salt, recommended by
        Dr. Burford and others as the best preparation of gold in cases of uterine induration and
        hæmorrhage.



Relations. ─     Compare:
        Aur. mur. nat., Hydrastinin. mur.
